proposal.root_cause: Commit 44c62587e7b2cd09c010a7685bb0a35a14654806 renamed the frontend-nginx ConfigMap key default.conf -> site.conf while deploy/demo/frontend.yaml still mounts subPath default.conf, breaking the bind mount and causing CrashLoopBackOff.
proposal.rationale: Pod frontend-6bd565ff7d-m5wfr is CrashLoopBackOff with exitCode 128: runc cannot bind-mount volume-subpaths/nginx-conf/frontend/1 onto /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf because the destination already exists as a directory (the nginx image ships a default.conf file there, but the subPath key no longer exists in the ConfigMap, so the mount source is wrong). The frontend Deployment (deploy/demo/frontend.yaml) mounts configMap frontend-nginx with subPath: default.conf. Commit 44c62587e7b2cd09c010a7685bb0a35a14654806 ("config: rename frontend nginx config key") renamed the ConfigMap key from default.conf to site.conf without updating the mount, so the subPath no longer resolves. Restoring the key name to default.conf (the last known good value, per the same diff) fixes the mount at the source.
proposal.verify: After Argo CD syncs the patch, the frontend-nginx ConfigMap has key default.conf again; new frontend pods start (no StartError/mount 'not a directory'), container frontend becomes Ready, and the pod reaches Ready with restartCount no longer increasing.

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/frontend.yaml
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: frontend
        app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: nginx:1.27-alpine
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          volumeMounts:
            - name: html
              mountPath: /usr/share/nginx/html/index.html
              subPath: index.html
              readOnly: true
            - name: nginx-conf
              mountPath: /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
              subPath: default.conf
              readOnly: true
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /
              port: 80
            periodSeconds: 5
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: 32Mi
              cpu: 25m
            limits:
              memory: 64Mi
              cpu: 250m
      volumes:
        - name: html
          configMap:
            name: frontend-html
        - name: nginx-conf
          configMap:
            name: frontend-nginx
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: frontend
  namespace: demo
  labels:
    app: frontend
    app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"
  annotations:
    repair.example.dev/source-path: deploy/demo/frontend.yaml
spec:
  type: NodePort
  selector:
    app: frontend
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 80
      targetPort: 80
      nodePort: 30080
